description: src/group_log/storage_tests.rs is a plain pub module in the source tree (not under #[cfg(test)]), so its test helper functions are compiled into the stoa-core rlib whenever any dependent crate builds without restricting to test profile. The module creates LogEntry values with empty operator_signature and calls MemLogStorage and SqliteLogStorage directly. This inflates binary size and exposes test surface in production. The module should be moved to a tests/ directory or gated behind #[cfg(test)] or the test-helpers feature.
title: core: storage_tests module is pub in src/ and ships in production builds
